verified: Microsoft's preliminary post-incident report, as reproduced by Office Watch and summarized by Ars Technica, gives the outage window of November 12 16:20 UTC to November 13 16:10 UTC, the November 14 monitoring period, the three contributing causes (latent gateway defect dormant since July, traffic changes, reduced server capacity), the "not related to cyber or AI/agents" classification, and incident IDs EX1550543 and MO1550821.
unconfirmed: Because the full report requires Microsoft 365 admin credentials, these details rest on Microsoft's own account and secondary reproductions; the report is explicitly preliminary, and no independent root-cause analysis, customer-count or financial-impact figures have been released.

verified: 微软的初步PIR给出中断窗口为11月12日16:20至11月13日16:10 UTC，监控延续至11月14日，编号EX1550543与MO1550821，并将原因归结为云网关潜伏缺陷（7月起潜伏）、流量变化和服务器容量下降三者共同作用，同时声明与网络攻击及AI/智能体无关。
unconfirmed: 报告的完整细节仅向持管理员凭据者开放，外界看到的是微软自述及Office Watch等第三方转载，根因分析没有独立验证；微软也未在报道中给出受影响租户数量、业务损失或SLA赔付等具体数字。

titles.en: Microsoft: latent gateway bug plus traffic and capacity cuts caused 24-hour M365 outage
titles.zh: 微软初步复盘：三个问题叠加导致近24小时M365全球中断
